defaults.composition: Wide open view across the meadow at standing height: young grass and a few wildflowers in the foreground, the meadow with its trees, hedges or woodland edge across the middle ground, and soft hills or forest with sky in the background, looking across the meadow, with far more green than flower color.

shots.subject: A gently rolling meadow of young grass with scattered buttercups and white daisies, a single spreading oak in fresh leaf and a beech woodland edge behind
